But requirement: do not modify @Before/@After. We can reinitialize inside test functions.

So we can use same approach but we need to manipulate schemas after construction: the schemas field is private final List<JsonSchema> schemas; maybe final but we can set via reflection. Or we can mock ValidationContext to return whatever schemas we want; the constructor uses validationContext.newSchema for each array element. So to get empty schemas list, we can have schemaArrayNode size 0. For null schemas list, we might need to use reflection to set field to null after construction.

Similarly for null child schema, we can have schemaArrayNode with two elements, but make validationContext.newSchema return null for first call.

Thus we can create custom validator per test using reflection to adjust schemas.

7. testWalk_MultipleChildSchemas_ValidateFalse: need three child schemas. Use reflection to set schemas list with three mocks. Then verify each walked once.
